EXPOSURE GRAPHILLUSTRATIVE

THE CHALLENGE

Why this is hard today.

Findings arrive as lists

Exposure data from different tools rarely shows how one issue leads to the next.

Access changes the picture

An exposed asset matters more when a privileged identity is associated with it.

Priorities are hard to defend

Without context, severity alone decides what gets looked at first.

HOW SAFORA HELPS

Three steps, one workspace.

  1. 01

    Map what is reachable

    Use the Adversarial Exposure Graph and Exposure Intelligence to explore exposed assets and the paths around them.

  2. 02

    Add the identity context

    Review associated access from Identity & Access in the same investigation.

  3. 03

    Follow it to the evidence

    Open a finding to see its assessment evidence, guidance, status and history.
